method: Read-only source comparison. Read spec 3.3 and 5.3, profiles.ts and sources.ts. Inventory used only to enumerate subject fields, never as an independent oracle. Read primary publisher/repository full texts where accessible; named abstract-only or blocked originals separately. Check Celsius number, predicate, actual measured variable, averaging/exposure duration, phenological stage, cultivar and geography. No tests, full check, build, code edits or remote comments.

workflow.playbook: Investigation, swarm audit partition; no nested agents per coordinator brief

standard: Spec 5.3 requires exact supported variable, period and stage. Transparent limitation prose does not establish scientific support for changing those dimensions. A treatment contrast cannot locate an unmeasured threshold.
